ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45% high-intensity (white) to 55% low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-contrast white regions located on the distal portions of each lobe. The left lobe contains a large triangular white patch extending from the outer tip towards the center. The right lobe contains a similarly sized white patch with irregular boundaries and black pixel intrusions along the trailing edge and median boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped median notch with a calculated angle of approximately 45 degrees and a well-defined focal depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant peak-to-valley pixel variance is observed, particularly on the distal tips where the edge appears jagged and irregular.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge exhibits a concave sweep from the outer tips toward the median notch, while the leading edge maintains a broad convex curvature.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of dark pixels (focal spots) are detected within the white fields on both lobes, including a distinct grouping of approximately 6-8 spots on the mid-right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned linear pixel disruptions are visible on the white field of the left lobe, appearing as thin dark streaks against the lighter background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular nicks and small notches along the trailing edge of both lobes, with a distinct indentation on the outer terminal edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique mottled 'fringe' pattern where the white and black pigmentation zones meet, characterized by a high-density mix of small black and white pixel clusters.
